item.title: Composing Atmospheres Workshop
item.description:
About the workshop

I collaborated with my sister, soon-to-be Phd in Architecture, for a workshop that explored the connection between architecture and music.

As I have some previous experience with composing music and I am a CS student, I was tasked with the following:

  1. Creating compositions based on students’ projects

  2. Creating an interactive website where someone can create a composition

Website

  • The website should be up at: https://composingatmospheres.ro/

  • The source code for the website should be available here: https://github.com/petru-robu/vibraspace

item.title: Write-up Secrecy-on-demand CTF
item.description:
Statement

This task holds a good-kept secret inside a portal from the app, find it and log in. You can try the most seen things to get it, but you will lose your time. Only the chosen ones will see it.

Tags: bypass, desync, web

Solution

From the tags we see desync, so maybe http smuggling could work.

First, let’s check http version:

> curl -I -v http://23.88.96.97:33079/login
*   Trying 23.88.96.97:33079...
* Connected to 23.88.96.97 (23.88.96.97) port 33079
* using HTTP/1.x
> HEAD /login HTTP/1.1
> Host: 23.88.96.97:33079
> User-Agent: curl/8.15.0
> Accept: */*

We are using http/1 requests

item.title: Composing atmospheres presentation at UAUIM
item.description:
Resources for students

  • The mixer is available at composingatmospheres.ro/mixer and you can play around to create your sounds.

    • To play a cell, press the play button. For each cell you have volume and panning (left, right) controls

  • Here is a drive with .wav files of the sounds that are in the mixer.

  • You can try this online DAW or Audacity , simple DAWs to try out your ideas.
